issues.feedback: The spec’s lock assumption is incorrect. A project can be locked while not currently active (for example if another process switches active project after a run starts, or another command holds the project lock). Deleting without a lock check can remove a project mid-operation. Add a lock acquisition/lock-failure path before `remove_dir_all`.

The delete flow uses raw `project_id` to build a filesystem path. Without validating the ID format (`[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+`), a crafted value with separators or `..` can escape `.ralph/projects` and make `remove_dir_all` dangerous. Add explicit project-id validation for this command.

Acceptance criterion #4 (delete should succeed when no active project is set) is not covered by the proposed tests. Add a conformance test that clears the active-project file, then deletes an existing project and verifies success.
